review_type: single AI curator; full received final answer read; model identity visible; original rubric

errors.quote: Reconstitute the experimentally assigned reactions with individually characterized enzymes
errors.issue: The architecture is excellent, but the proposal leaves the actual preparation, carbon-entry substrate, intermediate/reaction map, complementary tracer positions and component/cofactor inventory largely deferred. Specify at least one justified concrete proposed system and compatible tracing/step-restoration route, while calibrating its unknown numerical conditions. A generic E1..Em network is less operational than the requested experimental plan.

rationale: Strong common-state blocked/restored comparison, separate routing and carbon-source tracer formats, uncertainty-aware pool bounds, isotope/carbon balances, direct step validation, defined omission/add-back and competing-model identifiability. It does not equate oxygen uptake or label appearance with recycling. Main shortcoming is an abstract implementation whose biochemical identities remain to be selected.
reference_guardrails: Personally read the complete final answer, exact question/packet and entire frozen reference answer including its curator clarification. No hidden reasoning, paid judge or laboratory execution.
This uses the existing first-round rubric. The owner requested a stricter second round only after completion of this round; new 10/5-point deductions have not been applied.
The packet explicitly says the 1937 full text and figures were not read. Do not attribute proposed experimental details to the historical paper or penalize absence of invented historical settings.

The preliminary key mentions a noncycling analog and a small fixed discovery n. Its clarification permits omission/restoration where no validated analog exists. Independent sample size should be powered/calibrated; no particular small n is required.
Do not demand a positive addition effect in an already saturated endogenous pool. Failure to meet a proposed support gate limits the conclusion and does not automatically falsify cycling.

Adding downstream carbon around an irreversible block does not restore the missing reaction. Label exchange or appearance in one pool does not establish net cycle flux; respiration alone is insufficient.

Initial pools, mobilizable reserves, carbon sources, washout losses, cofactor-regeneration reactions and reversible exchange need accounting. Carbon closure alone cannot distinguish all network topologies.
Unknown numeric settings can be calibrated; concrete proposed biochemical routes are nevertheless useful. No complete primary-source methods audit is claimed.
